name: forestmanager
description: Forest Manager - espaces prives organises en modules (recettes, planning, courses)

scripts.docker:up:build: docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose.dev.yml up -d --build --renew-anon-volumes && docker image prune -f
scripts.test: docker compose -p forestmanager-test --project-directory . -f docker/compose.test.yml run --rm --build tests
scripts.test:api: docker compose -p forestmanager-test --project-directory . -f docker/compose.test.yml run --rm --build tests npx vitest run --configLoader runner --project @fm/api
scripts.test:web: docker compose -p forestmanager-test --project-directory . -f docker/compose.test.yml run --rm --build tests npx vitest run --configLoader runner --project @fm/web
scripts.test:shared: docker compose -p forestmanager-test --project-directory . -f docker/compose.test.yml run --rm --build tests npx vitest run --configLoader runner --project @fm/shared
scripts.prisma:migrate: docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose.dev.yml exec api npm exec --workspace=@fm/api -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:studio: docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose.dev.yml exec api npm exec --workspace=@fm/api -- prisma studio --port 5555 --browser none

author: Matthias Bouloc
